description: Eval corpus tiering manifest. Single source of truth for strong-vs-weak fixture classification. runner.ts reads THIS file (not fixture-internal groundtruth_quality) to bucket precision/recall, avoiding dual-source drift between the manifest and per-fixture metadata.

strong.rationale: Post-cleanup: removed all imported weak data (59 fixtures) and 3 junk auto-collected (080/088/089). case_066 reclassified drift=true (false_environment_assumption is drift). fixture_114-116 demoted to unevaluable (skeleton fixtures with empty tool_call events, premature_completion signal pending real data).

weak.rationale: Weak-but-evaluable: goal is thin/short/broad but carries some intent. Cleaned of imported and junk fixtures.

unevaluable.rationale: EXCLUDED from drift P/R/F1. Includes: (1) case_066 reasoning_failure reclassified as drift and moved to strong; (2) fixture_112/113 clean sessions retained for boundary testing; (3) fixture_114-116 skeleton premature_completion fixtures (have goal but tool_call events are empty shells — no tool names, no descriptions — detector cannot score).
